## 321b71aa828c

**Classification: reproduced training-data shortcut / distribution defect.**
Audited generator SHA-256:
`8018856a9bb70eaf5008ec2089104d68ec5dd26d13fd92c91a16d4d92f8af579`;
executed rule hash `e8b7695ca10a`.

The ordinary generator emits one structural signature: markers at fixed
coordinates `(0,0),(0,2),(2,0),(2,2)`, four fixed object bounding-box tops,
exactly four markers and four objects, a complete 2×2 layout, and 3-cell objects.
A fixed-coordinate recoloring shortcut matched the independent authority mirror
on 300/300 samples (100 per band), with zero `self_check` errors. A separate
Racket batch confirmed the same shortcut on 60/60 generator-valid inputs.

The shortcut fails every canonical pair. The retained decisive counterexample is
canonical `train[1]`, a sparse 3×3 / six-object layout. The audited generator's
`self_check` accepts it; Racket reproduces the canonical label; the fixed-coordinate
shortcut differs. Input SHA-256:
`9aa08d1c13dc922496aeb393cdc16a668ece563b345d3ba8bf770c1614c29dcc`.
Reproduction files:

- `checks/audit/321b71aa828c/input.json`
- `checks/audit/321b71aa828c/expected_canonical.json`
- `checks/audit/321b71aa828c/rival.json`
- `checks/audit/321b71aa828c/racket.json`
- `checks/audit/321b71aa828c/counterexample_comparison.json`
- `checks/audit/321b71aa828c/generated_batch_comparison.json`
- `checks/audit/321b71aa828c/distribution_probe.json`

The audit battery also found no task-local tests and no executable semantic
contract, so there was no automated teaching gate to challenge the fixed layout.
This is actionable even though every sampled generated label is individually
correct: a learner can fit all ordinary lessons with a shortcut that fails an
accepted canonical task instance. No audited source was edited.
